meta.area: HydroSHEDS HydroBASINS level 8, all sub-basins with MAIN_BAS = 2080014490

fields.id: EEA 1 km reference grid code: lower-left corner in km, ETRS89-LAEA (EPSG:3035)
fields.basin: share of the square inside the area (0-1)
fields.crop: share that is cropland: ESA WorldCover 2021, class 40
fields.arable: share that is non-irrigated arable land: CORINE 2018, class 211
fields.rainfed: share that is both: the project's rain-fed arable mask
fields.arable22: share in any arable crop: EU crop map 2022, classes 211-290
fields.durum18, durum22: share mapped as durum wheat: EU crop map 2018 and 2022, class 212
fields.farm: true if rain-fed arable covers at least 10% of the square; later notebooks work these out first

hydrosheds.name: HydroSHEDS HydroBASINS level 8
hydrosheds.licence: HydroSHEDS licence: free for non-commercial and commercial use, with attribution
hydrosheds.cite: Lehner, B. & Grill, G. (2013). Hydrological Processes 27(15): 2171-2186. www.hydrosheds.org

worldcover.name: ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200
worldcover.cite: Zanaga, D. et al. (2022). ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200. doi:10.5281/zenodo.7254221

corine.name: CORINE Land Cover 2018
corine.licence: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service: free, full and open access, with attribution
corine.cite: European Union, Copernicus Land Monitoring Service 2018, European Environment Agency (EEA)

eucropmap.name: EU crop map 2018 and 2022 (JRC)
eucropmap.cite: d'Andrimont, R. et al. (2021). Remote Sensing of Environment 266: 112708; Ghassemi, B. et al. (2024). Scientific Data 11: 1048

nasadem.name: NASADEM elevation
nasadem.licence: NASA data: no restrictions on use
nasadem.cite: NASA JPL (2020). NASADEM Merged DEM Global 1 arc second V001. doi:10.5067/MEaSUREs/NASADEM/NASADEM_HGT.001

meta.ai_assistance: Produced by notebooks written with AI assistance (Claude, Anthropic) and run by the Field Shift team in Google Colab with Google Earth Engine. Data values come from the cited datasets and were not written by the AI, except a few published values from the trial at the demo field (its station's rain and temperature, and its soil description), which were copied by hand from Denora et al. (2025) and are labelled as such.
